Surrounded by the applause of the crowd, Caracciola crossed the finish line after 2h17m39.3s, Lang followed 49 seconds behind in second place, 17 seconds ahead of Brauchitsch and Stuck's Auto Union one second further behind.
Rosemeyer in Nuvolari's car finished fifth. Mercedes-Benz had achieved a triple victory with Kautz in the fourth Mercedes placed sixth, one lap down.
